user.title: Entity Watchguard
user.description: Choose the domains to watch for unavailable entities. Everything else (timings, recovery, exceptions, notifications) can be adjusted later via the options.

error.no_domains: Please select at least one domain.

timing.title: Timings
timing.description: The startup delay starts counting once Home Assistant has finished starting — entities often need a few minutes to become available.

data.grace_period: Grace period before an entity is reported

recovery.title: Recovery
recovery.description: Stage 1 asks Home Assistant to poll the entity again. Stage 2 reloads the config entry the entity belongs to — more effective, but all entities of that integration disappear briefly.

data.reload_cooldown: Minimum time between reloads of the same config entry
data.max_recovery_attempts: Give up after this many stage 2 attempts (0 = never give up)

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.description: Excluded entities are never reported and never recovered. Integrations are matched by the integration that provides the entity (e.g. shelly, mqtt, hue). Patterns are regular expressions matched against the entity ID, e.g. .*_internet_access$

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: One persistent notification per domain; it updates itself and is dismissed automatically once the domain is clean again. Repair issues show up under Settings → Repairs and can be ignored per domain. A notify service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone) is only called when a domain starts or stops having a problem, not on every check.

error.no_domains: Please select at least one domain.
error.invalid_pattern: At least one pattern is not a valid regular expression.

unavailable_entities.title: {count} unavailable {domain} entities

recover_now.name: Recover now
recover_now.description: Immediately attempts to recover the currently unavailable entities, ignoring the configured delays.

domain.name: Domain
domain.description: Limit the attempt to a single domain, e.g. light.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Limit the attempt to these entities.

escalate.name: Escalate
escalate.description: Also run stage 2 (reload the config entry).

clear_notifications.name: Clear notifications
clear_notifications.description: Dismisses all persistent notifications created by Entity Watchguard.
